Name: Lumisteria Giant Crops for Ancient Crops
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mod adds 6 giant crops for the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4472]Ancient Crops[/url].
You can now get giant crops for :
- Ancient Flower
- Ancient Tuber
- Ancient Fern*
- Ancient Nut*
- Ancient Olive*
- Ancient Coffee*

Unlike vanilla crops, those will require a pattern of 3*2 to have a chance to appear, aka :
XXX
XXX
Since this pattern is more flexible, they have a default chance that is, by default, lower than classic giant crops. This can be configured for each crop.

* [u]Important Note :[/u]
Regrowable giant crops are [b]DISABLED [/b]by default; because vanilla behaviour is to replace the crop with the giant crop, making the crop actually disappears on harvest, even regrowable crops.
Enable them only if you are fine with the risk of a giant ancient coffee to appears on the first harvest of your precious ancient coffee bean OR if you use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14370]Giant Crop Tweaks[/url], as it will allows regrowable crops to actually regrow when the giant crop is harvested. (My suggestion is to use Giant Crop Tweaks, because it's cool, and allows also some extra features like giant crops anywhere!)

Thanks to 6480 for the crop art, that was used for the colors and some elements, and the permission to publish this mod.

(Are there more giant crops mods coming? Maybe!)
